top_signals.title: Europe’s Leaders Lack Tools to Ease War-Driven Energy Shock
top_signals.summary: European Union leaders are searching for ways to ease soaring energy prices, but President Donald Trump’s war against Iran has left them with few affordable options.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin dips to $80.1K as KOSPI closes at its lowest since April
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin price action continued to see contagion from a Korean tech sell-off after the KOSPI Index fell 7.5% on Thursday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: France’s Bond Turmoil Leaves Repo Funding Unscathed for Now
top_signals.summary: The shock from turmoil in French debt has yet to show up in the country’s market for short-term funding, signaling a broad credit crisis is off the cards for now.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
